services.name: Bus Tours
services.desc: This self-guided tour through the Historic Village allows you to see all 68 of our historic buildings to better understand what like may have been like in Upstate New York 200 years ago. Students will participate in a real Naturalization Ceremony, welcoming new American citizens! This is a moving and joyous ceremony that should not be missed! During this guided field trip, your class will rotate through hands-on activities, a nature walk, a live animal presentation, and games. Our naturalists will guide your class on an interactive, inquiry-based walk through the Museum’s woodland and meadow habitats. Students will explore erosion, fossils, biodiversity, competition for natural resources,
